response:
Based on the search results conducted on August 6, 2026, here are the real, publicly available API rate limits and pricing tiers for The Odds API:

## Rate Limits
The Odds API has a rate limit of **30 requests per second** on paid usage plans. This is explicitly stated in their documentation. However, they note that even when sending requests below this limit, users might still encounter 429 errors due to network conditions and traffic scaling. [the-odds-api.com](https://the-odds-api.com/guide/rate-limit.html)

When rate limiting occurs, the API returns HTTP status code 429. The documentation recommends spacing out API calls over several seconds and retrying after a brief delay when encountering this error. [the-odds-api.com](https://the-odds-api.com/liveapi/guides/v4/api-error-codes.html)

## Pricing Tiers
The Odds API operates on a credit-based pricing system with publicly published tiers:

- **Free Starter Plan**: 500 credits per month across all sports, most bookmakers, all betting markets, and historical odds
- **Paid Tiers**: Range from a 20,000-credit plan at $30 per month up to a 15,000,000-credit plan at $249 per month [apibetting.com](https://www.apibetting.com/providers/the-odds-api)

## Credit Costs
The credit cost per request depends on the type of request and parameters used:

- **Standard Odds Requests**: Cost = [number of markets specified] × [number of regions specified]
- **Historical Odds Requests**: Cost = 10 × [number of markets specified] × [number of regions specified] (only available on paid plans) [the-odds-api.com](https://the-odds-api.com/liveapi/guides/v4/)

## Usage Tracking
Users can monitor their credit usage through HTTP response headers returned with every API call:
- `x-requests-remaining`: Usage credits remaining until quota reset
- `x-requests-used`: Usage credits used since last quota reset
- `x-requests-last`: Usage cost of the last API call [the-odds-api.com](https://the-odds-api.com/liveapi/guides/v4/api-error-codes.html)

All information was verified from The Odds API's official documentation and third-party review sites as of the search date.
